description: Ex-RNZAF No. 14 Squadron MB-339CB, construction number 6799/172, mounted on a pole as the gate guard outside Wanaka Airport. The RNZAF bought 18 MB-339CBs in the late 1980s as lead-in trainers for the A-4K; the type was retired with the air combat force in 2001 and the survivors were stored for a decade before disposal.
